title: Push Dominoes
description: There are `n` dominoes in a line, represented by a string `dominoes` where `'L'` means the `i`-th domino was pushed left, `'R'` means it was pushed right, and `'.'` means it was not pushed. Each second, a falling domino pushes its adjacent upright domino in the same direction; a domino pushed equally from both sides simultaneously stays upright. Return the string representing the final state.
hints: Consider each maximal segment of '.' bounded by non-dot symbols (using virtual 'L' at index -1 and 'R' at index n).
If both boundaries match ('L'..'L' or 'R'..'R'), fill the middle with that symbol; if 'R'..'L', push inward from both ends leaving the exact middle '.' if odd.

examples.explanation: Each pushed domino knocks over the single adjacent dot until balanced.
Opposing 'R' and 'L' forces meet in the middle, leaving an odd center upright.
No domino is pushed, so all remain upright.
